notes.title: Knightly Passions Version 1.6 — Release!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41018186/e877dea7d842e244f59666d2473718f315c6a244.png

Dear friends,

We’re pleased to present you with a new update of Knightly Passions — Version 1.6. This update was essential to fulfilling the many wishes and requests our players have shared since the game’s Steam release. Also, Version 1.60 is the final step towards beginning to translate the game into additional languages. We know how many of you have been waiting for greater language support. Patience, friends! More languages will be coming soon!

What awaits you in this update? Here’s the full list of all the changes and additions to the game:

 Added “New Game+” mode. This will be unlocked after completing the game for the first time. In this mode, you can choose to skip whichever quests you wish when you start a new game (especially useful for people trying to collect all the game’s achievements or replay specific quests without a convenient save).
 Added BONUS SCENES to the gallery (five old 18+ scenes). Please note: This is not new content. We’ve decided to show you scenes that were originally intended to be part of the game, but were later replaced by remade Live2D versions. You can compare the old versions to the new ones to see how much the animation quality has improved. One of the scenes was completely cut out; it will be new to many players.
 All major characters now have names. The following characters received names: the tavern keeper, the witch, the blonde nun, the vampiress, and the arms trader.
 The comic-style segment with the elf’s “tail” has returned, and we’ve improved the text in the elf’s 18+ scene. The comic-style segment was cut in the past due to plot changes.
 Partially fixed the combat bug involving enemy attack animations. If you’ve encountered animation problems in combat, you can enable/disable attack animations by clicking on the action point bubble in the combat screen.
 Added the ability to sort inventory items. Simply click on the “Sort” button in your inventory screen and your items will be put in order.
 Traders’ stocks now refresh daily. Previously, items sold to traders appeared as available to be bought back long after you’d sold them. Now, you can only buy back items you sold earlier the same day. The entire stock will refresh at the end of the day and any items you’ve sold to a trader will disappear.
 Improved dialogues with the elf inside the player’s house.
 Fixed a bug with the achievement for opening all 18+ scenes in the gallery.
 Fixed a bug with the scale of flying serpents in combat.
 Improved the text in the 18+ scene in the field with Mirina (and removed the “to be continued” text).
 Fixed a bug with Quest 22 still appearing in the journal after it had been completed.
 Fixed minor trading bugs.
 Fixed many other bugs and probably added new ones.
 And much more.

Friends, thank you so very much for your support! Thank you to everyone who not only helps the project financially, but also shares their ideas and thoughts about the gameplay. Your feedback in comments, private messages, and emails is genuinely invaluable!

Thank you for your tremendous support, your faith in our team, and of course, your LOVE for the game! It’s thanks to you that we’re able to keep marching forward! A huge, heartfelt THANK YOU to each and every one of you!

Sincerely,
Team FEYADA

notes.title: Release — Knightly Passions: In the Grip of Ice!
notes.content:
Dear friends,

The long-awaited winter-themed DLC, “In the Grip of Ice,” has just been released on Steam!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41018186/1ee111bb7f5062c371bf9bb4a1b2ad60ff91bdea.png
In this add-on, you must contend with the machinations of icy powers intent on shattering the town’s peace at any cost. To defeat this evil, you’ll have to infiltrate the perilous Ice Palace, where devious traps and merciless guardians await uninvited guests around every corner. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41018186/c5c97741e98f56554e7c50a12e2d6fc9aa4334c1.jpg

Will our dauntless hunter find the courage to challenge the Ice Queen? And will he have the compassion to thaw her frozen heart?

To celebrate the release, the DLC is being offered at a 10% discount.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3163410/Knightly_Passions_In_the_Grip_of_Ice/

This DLC will also be included in the Platinum Edition bundle:

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/44858/Knightly_Passions__Platinum_Edition/

Additionally, we’ve updated the main game to version 1.30. Here’s the full change log:

 Fixed most of the spelling errors in the original Russian text, which will allow us to translate the game into other languages.
 Added sound effects for opening the journal/inventory, pressing buttons, spending/receiving gold, etc.
 Reworked notifications (“Quest completed!”, “Task completed!”, “Item received!”, etc.)
 Corrected sprite expressions in Quests 1 and 3.
 Fixed a mistake in Quest 11.
 Fixed several bugs.
 And much more.

We’re so grateful to you all for supporting us! Friends, without you, we wouldn’t be able to pour all our heart and passion into the games we make. Thank you very much!

Sincerely,
Your FEYADA Team

notes.title: Fixes to the Main Game and DLC!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41018186/aebead656d5891c8e0e112dd4570b94e04f48030.jpg
Dear friends,

We just implemented some changes to the Knightly Passions base game and the Between Life and Death DLC. Here’s the full changelog:

- Improved the catching of quest fish. Now, if you have both of the quests involving fishing active (meaning that you need to catch 2 different legendary fish, each in a different location), you’ll be able to catch both fish in their respective fishing areas without having to complete one of the quests first. Previously, if you had both quests active, you had to first complete one of the quests and turn in the associated legendary fish before you could catch the legendary fish for the other quest.
- Fixed an issue in the main questline of the base game where a side quest could prevent you from speaking to the witch to advance the main questline (because the side quest prevented her from being in her hut). The main questline is now prioritized over the side quest in that situation.
- Implemented new fixes for the gallery. All DLC scenes now unlock correctly.
- Nerfed some DLC enemies and buffed others. DLC enemies are now approximately at a medium difficulty level.
- Fixed some minor bugs and translation issues.

Also, it’s worth mentioning that today we added a discounted Platinum Edition bundle to Steam. Purchasing it will give you all of our Knightly Passions content on Steam:

- Knightly Passions (the base game)
- Knightly Passions: Between Life and Death (DLC)
- The Knightly Passions Soundtrack (an album comprised of the game’s 40 unique songs)
- The Knightly Passions Bonus Pack (a collection of pictures and sketches, as well as illustrations not included in the final version of the game)

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41018186/9dff7be0919c7e33f9abe97653dbd503f72a2b7e.png
Dear friends,

Today, we’re releasing a new update, Version 1.21, which contains several bug fixes. Here’s the full changelog:


 Fixed a crash when loading old saves. Friends, please remember not to try loading saves from a demo version of the game or a version preceding the 1.0 release. If you attempt to load such a save, you’ll encounter errors because the old save does not know how to correctly interact with the many new mechanics we’ve implemented in subsequent versions of the game, causing a version conflict.
 Fixed a rare game crash related to catching artifacts while fishing.
 Cheat codes now correctly unlock all of the 18+ gallery scenes. 


If you encounter any problems with the game, be sure to tell us about them in our Discord server. 
Link: https://discord.gg/4WX4mn3NZM

We’d like to express our profound gratitude to everyone who’s helping us make this project even better!

Sincerely, 
Team FEYADA

notes.title: Knightly Passions 1.2! RELEASE!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41018186/7783b5ed7d2b15b68f950f3384ead05c17826381.png
Dear friends, 

It’s our pleasure to present you with a new version of Knightly Passions, Version 1.2. This is a technical update in which we’ve done quite a bit of work on a number of details. 

So, here’s the full list of all the changes in this update:

 Strengthened enemies in Tactical Mode, where the game has become more challenging and more interesting.
 Modified the attributes of enemies in Adventure Mode.
 Added the ability to replay a battle after dying.
 Adjusted the randomness of the fishing minigame. Catching rare fish is now easier.
 Added a “skip” button to the “escape the kurdles,” “escape the bear,” and “chase the bird” minigames.
 Added a DLC button to the main menu.
 Reduced how long you need to hold down on a skill to upgrade it in the skill menu.
 Reduced the number of kurdles in the “escape the kurdles” minigame by 25%, making it easier.
 In Adventure Mode, you can now attempt to catch the horse an unlimited number of sequential times.
 Added a “skip” button to the horse chase.
 Fixed a crash in the “memorize and repeat” minigame on one of the chests that occurred if buttons were pressed too quickly.
 Fixed version checking for saves. (Previously, the game allowed players to load saves from older game versions, resulting in errors.)
 Fixed several minor bugs.

We're offering a 10% discount on the base game and a 24% discount on the gold edition on Steam!

Dear players, thank you all for supporting us and playing the game!

Join our Discord:
https://discord.com/invite/4WX4mn3NZM

notes.title: Version 1.04 (Bugfix Patch). Steam Cloud, Remote Play, etc.
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41018186/1f92b97331ac9c35f6196f7c117a9539d3dc918d.png

Dear friends,

We’ve just released a new update, Version 1.04, that contains several bugfixes:


 The HP bars of enemies now appear where they’re supposed to during combat. Previously, the HP bars of certain enemies were concealed behind the player’s cards.
 The “Targeted Reflection” combat skill card now works as intended. Your current defense value is no longer lowered by using it.
 The chance of catching a question-mark item is now 5% when fishing.
 Fixed certain achievements resetting when attempting to start a new game (namely: Haggler, Jack-Of-All-Trades, Craftsman, Chef, “You Know, You Want to Live,” Overnight, and “Okay, I’ll Bite.”)

Today, we also set up cloud saving via the Steam Cloud with support for cross-platform saves, implemented the Remote Play option, and implemented Family Library Sharing. Please give these features a try and let us know if any of them are broken or not functioning as intended.

Thank you to everyone who’s written us messages in comments and reviews! We rarely have time to respond directly due to our workloads, but we’re reading every one of your messages. Thank you to all the players who’ve purchased and played our game! Thank you to all of you, friends! You’re the greatest!

notes.title: Version 1.02 (Bugfix Patch)
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41018186/96943e1f2cd47befa93f5b5d5864c2227218ec3c.png
Dear friends,

We've just updated the game to Version 1.02. The main fix of 1.02 is correcting the behavior of loaded save files. In Version 1.01, loading a save could make the game roll back your progress, causing it to be lost. Now, in Version 1.02, loading a save will not trigger such a rollback and no progress will be lost when loading saves.

We've also fixed issues with the dropping of certain Steam achievements.

We're seeing your lightning-fast feedback in comments and discussions, and it sounds like some players are encountering problems with the gallery. We also see that some people are encountering other errors. As soon as we work out these bugs, we'll release a new bugfix update and notify you of it immediately in a news post.

We apologize for any inconvenience these bugs have caused. We hear you; we just need a little time to fix up the game.
